sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们也是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为您带来《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的两人才能告诉您的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Well, hello, hello.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好啊。

sentences.en: What is this energy?
sentences.zh: 这股劲头是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道。

sentences.en: I brought my roller skates today.
sentences.zh: 我今天带了旱冰鞋来。

sentences.en: Oh, this is roller skate energy.
sentences.zh: 噢，原来是旱冰鞋带来的劲头。

sentences.en: Uh-huh, uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼，嗯哼。

sentences.en: You said you were going to do this.
sentences.zh: 你说过你要这么做的。

sentences.en: I'm skating through The New Office.
sentences.zh: 我要滑着穿过新办公室。

sentences.en: I want to show it to you guys.
sentences.zh: 我想展示给你们看。

sentences.en: You might remember Angela skated through Earwolf.
sentences.zh: 你们可能还记得安吉拉曾在 Earwolf 滑过旱冰。

sentences.en: And when we came in here for a meeting, she noticed the floors were good for roller skating again.
sentences.zh: 当我们来这儿开会时，她发现这里的地板又适合滑旱冰了。

sentences.en: So like any 53-year-old, I brought my roller skates.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像任何一个53岁的人一样，我带上了我的旱冰鞋。

sentences.en: And you're going to roller skate today.
sentences.zh: 你今天真的要滑旱冰吗？

sentences.en: Just a middle-aged lady skating through her office.
sentences.zh: 就是一个中年女士在办公室里滑旱冰而已。

sentences.en: Well, this is what you're bringing today.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是你今天带来的惊喜。

sentences.en: And I like it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢。

sentences.en: I'm here for it.
sentences.zh: 我支持你。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Guess what we're talking about today.
sentences.zh: 猜猜我们今天要聊什么。

sentences.en: Stairmageddon.
sentences.zh: 《楼梯大灾难》。

sentences.en: It's season nine, episode 20, written by Dan Sterling and directed by Matt Sohn.
sentences.zh: 这是第九季第20集，由丹·斯特林编剧，马特·索恩执导。

sentences.en: Matt Sohn sent in some wonderful director's perspective audio clips on this.
sentences.zh: 马特·索恩发来了一些关于这一集的精彩导演视角音频片段。

sentences.en: He's just the beSt.
sentences.zh: 他真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I know we've said this, but the other day I was at the grocery store and I ran into him.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们说过很多次，但前几天我在杂货店碰到了他。

sentences.en: And I was getting takeout and I had all these bags.
sentences.zh: 当时我正去取外卖，手里提着大包小包。

sentences.en: And Matt was like, Angela, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 马特问我：安吉拉，你在干嘛？

sentences.en: And he walked across the parking lot, scooped up my bags, and walked me to my car.
sentences.zh: 然后他穿过停车场，帮我拎起袋子，一直送我到车边。

sentences.en: You know, we describe every person as the best, but it's because they are.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们总说每个人都是最棒的，那是因为他们确实如此。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: We were so fortunate.
sentences.zh: 我们真是太幸运了。

sentences.en: We were.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: All right, everyone.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位。

sentences.en: Here's your summary for Stairmageddon.
sentences.zh: 这是《楼梯大灾难》的剧情梗概。

sentences.en: The building's elevator is being repaired.
sentences.zh: 大楼的电梯正在维修。

sentences.en: And Stanley is not pleased.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: He refuses to use the stairs.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝走楼梯。

sentences.en: It's a whole thing.
sentences.zh: 这闹得沸沸扬扬的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Dwight has to use some unconventional tactics to force Stanley to join him on a sales call.
sentences.zh: 德怀特不得不采取一些非传统的手段，强迫斯坦利和他一起去拜访客户。

sentences.en: And the first newspaper review of the documentary is published.
sentences.zh: 纪录片的第一篇报纸评论发表了。

sentences.en: This is going to lead to a lot of things, including Angela having to publicly defend Senator Lipton.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一系列连锁反应，包括安吉拉不得不公开为利普顿参议员辩护。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Toby and Nellie act as sort of sounding boards, surrogate therapists for Jim and Pam's relationship.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，托比和奈莉充当了吉姆和帕姆关系的倾听者和代理治疗师。

sentences.en: Yeah, sort of relationship guides, these two, Nellie and Toby.
sentences.zh: 是啊，内莉和托比这两个人，算是某种关系指南吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Interesting choice.
sentences.zh: 很有意思的选择。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And yet, worked out.
sentences.zh: 但结果还挺不错。

sentences.en: Yet, like some real nuggets there.
sentences.zh: 不过，里面确实有些真知灼见。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: All right, everyone.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位。

sentences.en: For today's Top of Show, I'm going to kick things off with a fan question from Caitlin G.
sentences.zh: 今天的开场，我先从佛罗里达州米尔顿的凯特琳·G发来的粉丝提问开始。

sentences.en: in Milton, Florida.
sentences.zh: 来自佛罗里达州米尔顿。

sentences.en: Caitlin said, I have been waiting over four years to send this note.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳说，我等了四年多才写下这封信。

sentences.en: Stair-Mageddon is my favorite episode of The Office and possibly my favorite episode of television of all time.
sentences.zh: 《楼梯大灾难》是我最喜欢的《办公室》剧集，甚至可能是我这辈子最喜欢的电视剧集。

sentences.en: Caitlin, you love this one.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，你很喜欢这一集啊。

sentences.en: Loves it.
sentences.zh: 她超爱。

sentences.en: Caitlin says, the image of Stanley sliding down the stairs wearing that silly helmet and wrapped in bubble wrap makes me laugh to the point of tears every time I watch it.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳说，斯坦利戴着那个滑稽的头盔，裹着气泡膜从楼梯上滑下来的画面，每次看都让我笑到流泪。

sentences.en: Every time I've had a bad day or needed a pick-me-up, I put on this episode.
sentences.zh: 每当我心情不好或者需要打起精神时，我都会重温这一集。

sentences.en: It has been a bright spot through my PPD, my husband's military deployments, and a cross-country move with two toddlers during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在我产后抑郁、丈夫服兵役期间，以及疫情期间带着两个幼儿跨国搬家时，这一集一直是我生活中的一抹亮色。

sentences.en: Caitlin, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，天哪。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Caitlin said, I truly can't explain what a gift this particular episode has been to my life and how excited I am to hear y'all break it down.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳说，我真的无法形容这一集对我的人生来说是多么珍贵的礼物，我也非常期待听到你们对它的深度解析。

sentences.en: You two and your team are a joy to listen to.
sentences.zh: 听你们俩和你们团队的节目真是一种享受。

sentences.en: Thanks for putting such a positive, cozy thing out into the world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们为这个世界带来了如此积极、温暖的内容。

sentences.en: Ah, well, I'm so glad that this episode has brought you so much joy, and I hope that our breakdown of it will bring you more joy.
sentences.zh: 啊，我很高兴这一集能带给你这么多快乐，也希望我们对它的解析能让你收获更多快乐。

sentences.en: Same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I mean, Caitlin, you drove cross-country with two toddlers.
sentences.zh: 我是说，凯特琳，你带着两个幼儿跨国搬家。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And to have your husband deployed?
sentences.zh: 还要面对丈夫服兵役？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's a lot to hold.
sentences.zh: 那真的承受了太多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: We got another fan question about this episode from Kendall W in Phoenix, Arizona, who said,
sentences.zh: 我们还收到了亚利桑那州凤凰城的肯德尔·W关于这一集的粉丝提问，她说，

sentences.en: Please tell me Leslie David Baker will be a guest for this episode.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我莱斯利·大卫·贝克会作为嘉宾参加这一集的录制。

sentences.en: I loved his storyline.
sentences.zh: 我超爱他的故事线。

sentences.en: Well, Kendall, I am very excited because I have been holding on to this for months.
sentences.zh: 嗯，肯德尔，我非常兴奋，因为这件事我已经憋了好几个月了。

sentences.en: For months.
sentences.zh: 憋了好几个月了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So a while back, me and Leslie and Phyllis did a Cheerios commercial.
sentences.zh: 前阵子，我和莱斯利还有菲利斯拍了一个家乐氏麦片的广告。

sentences.en: We did a few.
sentences.zh: 我们拍了好几个。

sentences.en: You're probably seeing them now.
sentences.zh: 你们现在可能正看到这些广告。

sentences.en: They were directed by Zach Woods, phenomenal director, and he's so smart and funny.
sentences.zh: 它们是由扎克·伍兹执导的，他是一位了不起的导演，既聪明又风趣。

sentences.en: But the four of us on set together, it was like old times.
sentences.zh: 但我们四个人在片场聚在一起时，感觉就像回到了过去。

sentences.en: We were laughing so hard.
sentences.zh: 我们笑得特别开心。

sentences.en: I have all these pictures of us just cracking up between scenes.
sentences.zh: 我拍了好多我们在拍摄间隙开怀大笑的照片。

sentences.en: And we had lunch together on set, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在片场一起吃了午饭，珍娜。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It was so crazy because you were doing like a mini office reunion commercial.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了，因为当时你在拍一个迷你版的《办公室》重聚广告。

sentences.en: And then I was doing a mini office reunion commercial at the same time.
sentences.zh: 而我当时也在拍一个迷你版的《办公室》重聚广告。

sentences.en: We were in two different cities, and it was so crazy.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个不同的城市，这真是太巧了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Jenna, while you were doing your commercial, I was actually in St. Louis, which made me think
sentences.zh: 而且珍娜，当你拍广告的时候，我其实在圣路易斯，这让我想到

sentences.en: of you even more because not only am I with the castmates.
sentences.zh: 更喜欢你们，因为我不只是和演员们在一起。

sentences.en: But anyway, we were at lunch one day, and it was me and Leslie and Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 总之，有一天我们在一起吃午饭，当时有我、莱斯利和菲利斯。

sentences.en: And I turned to Leslie, and I'm like, Leslie, we have got to hear from you on Office Ladies
sentences.zh: 我转头对莱斯利说，莱斯利，我们一定要在《办公室女士》节目里听你聊聊

sentences.en: about your time on the office.
sentences.zh: 你在《办公室》剧组的那段时光。

sentences.en: And he was like, let's do it now.
sentences.zh: 他说，那我们现在就开始吧。

sentences.en: And I was like, right now?
sentences.zh: 我说，现在？

sentences.en: And I was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: And I was like, I grabbed my phone, and he specifically talked about this episode.
sentences.zh: 我掏出手机，他专门聊了这一集的内容。

sentences.en: So here is my lunch break interview on my cell phone with Leslie David Baker.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我在午休时用手机对莱斯利·大卫·贝克的采访。

sentences.en: It is delightful.
sentences.zh: 非常精彩。

sentences.en: Hello, Office Ladies listeners.
sentences.zh: 大家好，《办公室女士》的听众们。

sentences.en: I am sitting here on the set of our new Cheerios commercial with Phyllis and Leslie.
sentences.zh: 我现在正坐在我们新拍的 Cheerios 广告片场，和菲利斯以及莱斯利在一起。

sentences.en: And Leslie's right here next to me.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利就坐在我旁边。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我在这儿。

sentences.en: Hi, how's everybody?
sentences.zh: 嗨，大家好吗？

sentences.en: Right now, Leslie's eating a really cute sugar cookie with a bumblebee on it.
sentences.zh: 现在，莱斯利正在吃一块印着大黄蜂的可爱糖霜饼干。

sentences.en: And we just had lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们刚吃完午饭。

sentences.en: And Leslie, here are my Office Ladies questions for you.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利，这是我要问你的《办公室女士》相关问题。

sentences.en: All right, shoot.
sentences.zh: 好，尽管问吧。

sentences.en: How did you get your job on the office?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得到《办公室》那份工作的？

sentences.en: I got my job on the office.
sentences.zh: 我得到了《办公室》的工作。

sentences.en: Allison Jones called me in and said that she wanted me to audition for a show called The
sentences.zh: 艾莉森·琼斯打电话叫我过去，说她想让我为一个叫《办公室》的剧试镜，

sentences.en: Office based upon the British version.
sentences.zh: 那是基于英版改编的。

sentences.en: I had never watched it, but heard it was successful.
sentences.zh: 我之前从没看过，但听说它很成功。

sentences.en: Went to the first audition, had on a very nice press shirt suit tie, was looking very elegant
sentences.zh: 我去了第一次试镜，穿了一件非常漂亮的衬衫和西装，打着领带，看起来非常优雅

sentences.en: and dapper, did the audition.
sentences.zh: 且干练，完成了试镜。

sentences.en: She told me, said, OK, I want you to go to the callback.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，说，好的，我要你去参加复试。

sentences.en: But when you go to the callback, don't go in looking as crisp and pressed as you are.
sentences.zh: 但去复试的时候，别穿得像现在这样挺括、平整。

sentences.en: You want to come in looking kind of slumpy and kind of, you know, shirt wrinkled, disheveled,
sentences.zh: 你要看起来有点邋遢，你知道的，衬衫要皱皱巴巴、衣冠不整，

sentences.en: because you are at this paper company and you've been there for quite a time and you really don't want to be there.
sentences.zh: 因为你是在这家造纸公司工作，你已经在那里待了很久，而且你真的不想待在那里。

sentences.en: So I went to the audition, got to the callback audition.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了试镜，参加了复试。

sentences.en: I had another audition that day for another project.
sentences.zh: 那天我还有另一个项目的试镜。

sentences.en: And when I got to the office audition, there were about 50, 75 people there.
sentences.zh: 当我到达《办公室》试镜现场时，那里大约有 50 到 75 个人。

sentences.en: It's a very crowded room.
sentences.zh: 房间里非常拥挤。

sentences.en: And I looked and I thought, so wait a minute, all these people are ahead of me.
sentences.zh: 我看了看，心想，等等，这些人都在我前面。

sentences.en: I have time to go to my other audition.
sentences.zh: 我有时间去参加另一个试镜。

sentences.en: Hopped in the car, left, went to the other audition.
sentences.zh: 于是我跳上车，离开，去了另一个试镜地点。

sentences.en: On the way back, ran into a lot of traffic and ambulances and school buses and every senior citizen in the free world out driving.
sentences.zh: 在回来的路上，遇到了严重的交通堵塞，还有救护车、校车，以及自由世界里所有开车的老年人。

sentences.en: So when I got back, I got to sit down and do my reading with Phyllis Smith.
sentences.zh: 所以当我赶回来时，我坐下来和菲利斯·史密斯一起读了剧本。

sentences.en: Allison Jones said, oh, Leslie, thank you so much for being patient and waiting.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森·琼斯说，哦，莱斯利，非常感谢你的耐心等待。

sentences.en: They said you were in the restroom, you know, and I would just went, oh, yeah, OK.
sentences.zh: 他们说你刚才去洗手间了，我就顺着说，哦，对，好的。

sentences.en: No, my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不，这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: I didn't mind waiting at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不介意等待。

sentences.en: And sat down, read with Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 然后我坐下来，和菲利斯一起读剧本。

sentences.en: Greg Daniels told us, when you finish the scene on the paper, just keep going.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·丹尼尔斯告诉我们，当你们读完纸上的台词后，继续演下去。

sentences.en: He wanted us to do some improv.
sentences.zh: 他想让我们做一些即兴表演。

sentences.en: So I did.
sentences.zh: 所以我照做了。

sentences.en: So I incorporated what I had just gone through driving through rush hour traffic with Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 所以我把刚才在高峰期堵车时的经历融入到了和菲利斯的对手戏中。

sentences.en: And Phyllis was feeding me all the, you know, good vibes that she was feeding me.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯给了我所有，你知道的，她给我的那些很好的互动反馈。

sentences.en: And we bantered back and forth.
sentences.zh: 我们就这样一来一回地聊了起来。

sentences.en: And we looked up and the people at the casting table were laughing and, you know, cut me off and said, OK, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我们抬头看时，选角桌那边的人都在笑，你知道的，他们打断了我，说，好了，谢谢。

sentences.en: And I went outside.
sentences.zh: 然后我走到了外面。

sentences.en: Allison gave me two thumbs up.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森向我竖起了两个大拇指。

sentences.en: And I thought, you know, OK, she's just a sweet, loving, positive person.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，好吧，她只是个甜美、有爱心、积极向上的人。

sentences.en: And I probably won't hear anything.
sentences.zh: 我大概是没戏了。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, I got a call.
sentences.zh: 几周后，我接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: And next thing I knew, they said, you booked it.
sentences.zh: 接下来我所知道的，就是他们说，你被录用了。

sentences.en: So getting stuck in traffic kind of helped your audition.
sentences.zh: 所以堵车反而帮了你的试镜。

sentences.en: It helped a lot.
sentences.zh: 帮了大忙了。

sentences.en: And then after I booked it, then my agent announced to me that he was retiring from show business and turning his agency over to his best friend.
sentences.zh: 在我被录用之后，我的经纪人告诉我他要从演艺圈退休，把经纪公司交给他的好朋友。

sentences.en: And I went, oh, OK, no problem.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，好的，没问题。

sentences.en: And then while I was waiting to hear what happens with the office, the agency switched over to his best friend who had a heart attack and died.
sentences.zh: 就在我等着看办公室那边会发生什么的时候，经纪公司转交给了他的好朋友，结果那人突发心脏病去世了。
